QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] The Clash
QuestInfo.0: You, the Afinas knights, the villagers, and everyone else who can fight gather outside the castle walls. With no end of the monsters in sight, you do your best to hold your positions, but the line of defense is slowly being pushed back.
